content:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-usw2 GPU pool 'infer-prod' crossing saturation threshold. p95 queueing spiked to 1.2s, admission_control engaged. traces: https://grafana.redwood/infer-prod/queueing (auto)
Alex: seeing it on the nightwatch board too. latency jump around 22:12 UTC. A bunch of small routes affected, not single customer.
Jamal: checked headroom metric — usable GPU slots at 14%. admission rate-limiter set to 70% capacity is currently enforcing backpressure.
Lin: is this across all AZs in us-west-2 or single AZ? if single, we can shift some traffic.
Alex: looks regional, multi-AZ. spike correlates with a burst of PLG chat traffic + a scheduled internal vector-embedding job that started ~22:05.
Molly: pulling logs now. Agent logs show many short-lived sessions and high KV-cache miss rate (~68%). KV cache cold start increases per-token work.
Ops-Rotation: can we allow burst capacity? what's current reserved vs burst usage?
Jamal: Reserved (committed) pool is at 100% of reservation. Burst pool is used up; autoscaler hasn't added more nodes because cluster refill throttled by quota in eu-west-1 cross-region egress policy.
Lin: cross-region is messy — we can failover to euw1 but tail latencies will increase ~80-120ms. Also cost impact: egress ~ $0.09/GB for that routing.
Molly: quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce low-priority batch sizes and pause internal embedding job, 2) tweak admission control to prioritize low-latency routes, 3) warm KV cache for hot prefixes.
Alex: agree. Jamal — can you pause the embedding job? its job id is job-embed-9002.
Jamal: pausing now: `kubectl scale job job-embed-9002 --replicas=0` -> done.
Molly: applying admission tweak (temporary) to favor /api/v1/generate (low-latency) over /bulk/embeddings. patch:
```
admission_control:
  priority_buckets:
    - name: low_latency
      match: "/api/v1/generate"
      weight: 100
    - name: bulk
      match: "/bulk/embeddings"
      weight: 10
```
patched and rolled to canary (commit a1f3b9).
Jamal: drop batch size on the default worker from 16 -> 8 for latency SLOs. Command: `servicectl set-config infer-prod --batch-size=8` -> done.
Lin: I'll start a synthetic cache-warmup for top prefixes to reduce KV miss storm. Script queued.
Ops-Rotation: monitoring headroom now. p95 queue dropped to 420ms after changes. still above baseline but trending down.
Alex: good. keep an eye on admission throttles in the next 10m. we should also consider temporary increase of burst pool if cold start and traffic rebound, but need approval because cost+quota.
Oncall-Triage: who is owning follow-up / postmortem? need an incident tag and blameless notes.
Alex: I'll own the post-incident writeup. assign to #postmortems and label 'capacity-surge-usw2'.
Molly: adding dashboard panels for KV miss rate and embedding-job start times. Also adding an alert for 'internal batch jobs starting during peak hours' -> low-noise rule.
Jamal: note for follow-up: quota gating for cross-region burst is preventing automatic refill. need to update refill policy or pre-warm euw1 buffer.
Lin: will write a short RFC for regional failover + egress-cost cap.
Ops-Rotation: p95 queue now ~180ms and admission_control no longer actively throttling, queue length steady.
sre-bot: RESOLVED: Alert cleared at 22:50 UTC. Incident summary: short capacity surge driven by internal embedding job + KV cache cold-start, mitigated by pausing job, admission reweighting, batch size reduction, and cache warmup.
Oncall-Triage: thanks team. please add timelines to the doc. :white_check_mark:
